# Player search fixtures

`pear-search-overview.json` and `pear-search-songs.json` are reduced live Pear Desktop API responses captured on 5 September 2026 for the user-provided query `Diamante - Hear Me Now`.

Only the first six playable rows, video IDs, text columns, artist/album browse IDs and Songs/Videos filter parameters remain. Credentials, tracking parameters, thumbnails, menus, personal profile data and unrelated responses are excluded.

The overview returns `PLXzNgd-Wgw` with a play count and no length. The Songs filter returns the same video with `Bad Wolves • Disobey • 3:40`. Other recordings, including the acoustic version, have different video IDs and must not provide its duration.
